source_title: Will the Real Ubik Please Stand Up? Precognition of Scientific Information in the Fiction of Philip K. Dick
access_notes: Feature article in EdgeScience #20 (Dec 2014), the quarterly of the Society for Scientific Exploration (SSE). ISSN 2330-4545. Full machine-readable text available. Note the venue: SSE studies anomalous phenomena and is parapsychology-friendly.
notes: Secondary scholarship engaging PKD's precognition claims. The article's acknowledgments thank PKD's ex-wives (Anne Dick, Nancy Hackett, Tessa Dick) and several Dick scholars including Gregg Rickman, Frank Hollander, and Ted Hand (line 233).
